practicals.title: Experiment 1
content: To apply knowledge of types of cable, cable construction, cable
lying, cable joint, cable ratting & size, cable tray, lug and lug
crimping for connection to panel.

practicals.title: Experiment 2
content: To apply knowledge of types of wire, wire connector, wire rating,
wire laying, ferrule, terminal blocks and din rails with control panel
and understand fundamental of color code of wire.

practicals.title: Experiment 3
content: To apply the appropriate connections for different types of switches
(such as push-button, selector, rocker, rotary cam, emergency
switches, etc.) in an electrical panel according to the design
specifications.

practicals.title: Experiment 4
content: To apply knowledge of tools, safety equipment and testing
equipment during panel wiring.

practicals.title: Experiment 5
content: To Identify importance of different type of panel indicator lamp
with its operation.

practicals.title: Experiment 6
content: To understand connection of analog and digital instruments, also
perform connection of protective and control instruments- Fuse,
MCB, MCCB, RCCB and ELCB.

practicals.title: Experiment 7
content: To identify measuring instruments CT, PT, volt meter, ammeter,
frequency meter, energy meter, KW meter, PF meter, energy meter,
reactive power meter, multi-function meter for panel parameter
checking.

practicals.title: Experiment 8
content: To Identify different types of earthing and necessity of neutral and
grounding for an electric panel.

practicals.title: Experiment 9
content: To prepare general arrangement diagram of bus bar for panel
application with dimension

practicals.title: Experiment 10
content: To apply knowledge of relay and contactor as per application of
control panel.

practicals.title: Experiment 11
content: To select circuit breaker as per rating of control panel.

practicals.title: Experiment 12
content: To demonstrate interlocking in control panel.

practicals.title: Experiment 13
content: To use DC supply, inverter, UPS, battery and battery charger for
control and measuring purpose in an electrical control panel.

practicals.title: Experiment 14
content: To select distribution box for LT, HT, domestic, commercial,
industrial, LDB, MLDB ASB, HDB, MDB, MCB, MCCB types of
control panel

practicals.title: Experiment 15
content: To prepare layout and general arrangement drawing of internal
structure of panel.

practicals.title: Experiment 16
content: To identify and use different symbols, abbreviations, color code,
electrical code and standards for panel wiring and prepare diagram
according to requirement.

practicals.title: Experiment 17
content: To differentiate drawing of control circuit and power circuit of
control panel and prepare control and wiring diagram as per
requirement.

practicals.title: Experiment 18
content: To understand types of loads, load distribution, load calculation and
power management of panel.

practicals.title: Experiment 19
content: To identify specification of control panel as per requirement of
customer during visit.

practicals.title: Experiment 20
content: To prepared design of control panel as per connected load by using
various electrical, electronics and instrumentation component.

practicals.title: Experiment 21
content: To demonstrate procedure of installation, commissioning and
testing of control panel.

practicals.title: Experiment 22
content: To identify enclosure material, name plate details, capacity and
arrangement of panel.

practicals.title: Experiment 23
content: To identify faulty components, perform maintenance and
troubleshooting on the control panel, and analyze the protection
systems provided for the panel

practicals.title: Experiment 24
content: To understand, need, application, basic concept and essential
component of industrial automation.

practicals.title: Experiment 25
content: To understand basic concept of PLC, SCADA, DCS, HMI and
necessity of control system.

practicals.title: Experiment 26
content: To apply knowledge of PLC for design electrical control diagram of
suitable panel.

practicals.title: Experiment 27
content: To understand construction, types, working details, protection,
starter and its control circuit of electric drives.

practicals.title: Experiment 28
content: To demonstrate basic components, working details, protection,
application, soft starter and its control panel circuit of electrical
drives.
Total Hours 84
